concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-prepare-reports]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service checklist for report/fee selection, time-zone and column configuration, role-gated column edits, distinct retrieval routes and complete pre-live reconciliation tests; preparation is not report generation or financial-event proof.
warnings: Column-edit roles at raw lines 46–51 must not be generalized to authorization for all report generation or downloads.
The page routes to separate Adyen-account and balance-platform report retrieval guides, but does not itself prove a report file was generated or a transaction booked.
